summary: Model picker where one pixel swarm morphs between a diamond, a ring and a rotating star, with speed, depth and cost bars.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the user picks a model. `model` is `Swift`, `Balanced` or `Deep`. Not fired for the initial selection.

methods.description: Selects model 0 (`Swift`), 1 (`Balanced`) or 2 (`Deep`) and fires `change`. Other values are ignored.

keyboard.action: Select the previous model, wrapping around, and move focus to it.
Select the next model, wrapping around, and move focus to it.

accessibility: The model buttons sit in a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Model"`; each has `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`.
Roving tabindex: only the selected option is in the tab order.
The canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` naming the model and its speed, depth and cost scores out of 10.
motion: With reduced motion, pixels jump straight into the new shape instead of flying, and the shape does not rotate, breathe or jitter.
notes: The three models and their scores are built-in demo data: Swift (speed 10, depth 3, cost 2), Balanced (7, 7, 5) and Deep (4, 10, 9). Balanced is selected initially.

data.note: The three models and their speed, depth and cost scores are invented; nothing can be set.
